intro: Find mapped viewpoints and observation towers across {countries}. Choose a place to pause and take it in.
empty: No matching viewpoints mapped here. Try another type or a wider radius.
tileError: The map is unavailable. The viewpoint list still works.
footerText: Viewpoints and observation towers across {countries}, mapped by the OpenStreetMap community.
how2Text: Browse viewpoints and observation towers. Check mapped access, fees and elevation.
how3Text: Check terrain, weather and local access before setting out. Walking directions open in Google Maps.
DATA_NOT_READY: The viewpoint dataset is not ready yet. Please try again later.
sourceHours: Community map details may be outdated. Check local signs, weather and access before visiting.
openNowHint: Uses mapped opening hours. Unknown or uncertain hours are excluded; outdoor viewpoints are not assumed open 24/7.
touristDistanceNote: Distances are straight-line distances. Walking routes, elevation gain and terrain can make the journey longer; check a suitable route before setting out.
dataLicense: Location data: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Map tiles: OpenStreetMap. Icons: Lucide (ISC).
privacyText: Searches run on this site’s server. We do not store location history. Your language choice is saved only in this browser. OpenStreetMap receives your IP address and the map tiles you view. Google Maps opens only when you choose directions. Names and opening hours come from community map data and may be incomplete. Map labels follow the tile provider’s language. These public websites use Cloudflare Web Analytics to measure visits and site performance.
